newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London firmer, HSBC features.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London firmer, HSBC features.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London were a shade firmer on Wednesday with shares in HSBC Holdings featuring in otherwise subdued trade, dealers said.
Heavyweight banking group HSBC climbed 65 cents from its Hong Kong close to HK$220.65, dragged higher by its London listing which rose 13-1/2p to 18.03-1/2 stg by 1436 GMT.
The Hong Kong London Reference index rose 12.43 points to close at 14,247.95, near the high of the day, reflecting the broader firmness of the market.
In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng index closed down 0.68 points at 14,235.52 after profit taking erased earlier gains.
